title: Prove Int theory lemmas over their div/mod/abs atoms generalized
summary: Integer theory lemmas with farkas, bound, or cut hints over div, mod, abs, ite, or application atoms are now proved in Lean with those atoms generalized to fresh integers and the mod bounds stated, with the previous unfolded proof as fallback. The seed-67 stress certificate that exhausted maxHeartbeats now verifies in about 11 s.
